settings.language.title: Language
settings.language.hint: Follows the system language by default. Changes apply immediately.
settings.hook.title: Install hook
settings.hook.done: Hook installed! Restart Claude Code for it to take effect.
settings.title: Settings
settings.theme.title: Theme
settings.theme.hint: UI colors are derived from the terminal's 16 colors plus foreground/background, so any iTerm2 color scheme works as is. "Get themes" opens terminalthemes.com; download an .itermcolors file and import it.
settings.icons.title: Pane landing icon
settings.icons.none_hint: Only the name is shown when switching panes, without an icon.
settings.icons.hint: When you switch panes with ⌥⌘ + arrow keys or ⌥⌘ + number, the target pane shows an icon and its name in the center. Icons are fixed by pane number: pane N always gets icon N, the same N as in ⌥⌘N.
settings.notify.title: System notifications
settings.notify.approval: Notify when approval is needed (tool calls that need confirmation)
settings.notify.user: Notify when waiting for your answer (Claude is waiting for input)
settings.notify.completed: Notify when a task is done (silent banner, no interruption)
settings.notify.sound: Play a sound for alerts that need action
settings.notify.hint: Fires once each time a session enters the waiting state, and again only the next time it waits.
settings.notify.denied_hint: — banners will be dropped by the system. Turn it on in System Settings › Notifications › makit, or
settings.notify.not_wired: System notifications are not connected yet.
settings.notify.test_hint: Sends a banner right away to verify the pipeline, no need to wait for a real session to start waiting.
settings.hook.hint: Registers makit-hook.sh for four events in ~/.claude/settings.json: Notification, Stop, UserPromptSubmit and SessionEnd. Approval requests are pushed in real time, completion banners can quote Claude's own words, and unread marks clear when you send a message. If you installed an older version (Notification only), click again to fill in the rest.
settings.diagnostics.title: Diagnostics
settings.diagnostics.hint: Logs are saved per day in ~/.claude/makit/logs and kept for the last 7 days. They record startup, failures and key actions, never conversation content or terminal output, and the user name in paths is replaced with ~, but project folder names may still appear, so take a look before pasting them anywhere.
settings.about.title: About
settings.about.hint: When filing an issue, include this version and your macOS version; if something goes wrong, copy the diagnostics with the buttons under "Diagnostics" above.
settings.reflow.title: Conversation view
settings.reflow.hint: In tabs bound to a session, makit re-wraps the past conversation to the window width (it follows live as you resize), while the input box and menus remain a real terminal. Turn it off to get the plain terminal back. It has no effect in claude's fullscreen mode (tui: fullscreen).
settings.hover.title: Hover detail card
settings.hover.hint: On hover, a detail card (ID, path, branch, topic, etc.) pops up next to the session; click to copy.
settings.shortcuts.title: Keyboard shortcuts
welcome.tagline: Claude Code · Codex session manager · workspace terminal
welcome.trust: makit reads your session history (~/.claude, ~/.codex) on this machine and never uploads it; its own settings live in ~/.claude/makit.
welcome.step1: Run claude or codex in the terminal to start your first session
welcome.step2: Sessions show up in the sidebar automatically
welcome.step3: Click one to resume the conversation any time
welcome.row.locate: Locate the current session in the sidebar
welcome.row.panel_nav: Move up / down in a panel
welcome.row.open_in_split: Command palette: open in a split
welcome.lead: Click a session card in the sidebar to resume it; click a project worktree to start a new session; ⌘-click for a plain shell
status.hint.waiting: Needs a response: waiting for you to approve an action or answer a question
status.hint.busy: Running: the process is alive and producing output
status.hint.idle: Idle: the process is alive, open it to carry on right away
status.hint.stopped: Stopped: the process is gone, opening it resumes the previous context
sidebar.reveal.located_archived: Located (this session is archived, so archived sessions are now shown)
sidebar.reveal.not_in_list: Session not found (it may have no first message yet, or it was cleaned up)
sidebar.reveal.not_shown: Could not locate this session in the sidebar
sidebar.tooltip.new_session: New session in %{name} (⌘-click for a plain shell)
sidebar.toast.already_running: This session is already running (PID %{pid}) and cannot be started twice
sidebar.archive.confirm_detail: This session is running (PID %{pid}); archiving will close the terminal and kill its child processes.
